item.title: Why Everyone Thinks They’re Entitled To Your Location (And Your Other Etiquette Questions, Answered)

item.title: Vogue, As We Knew It, Is Dead
item.description: Vogue’s recent decision to publish an op-ed spitting on Brigitte Bardot’s legacy in the wake of her death has riled up critics online, leading many to wonder why the once iconic fashion magazine is defacing its own legacy with lazy, woke tone-policing. The truth is, with waning interest in print, Vogue has had to shift its publishing strategy to stay alive. But at what cost?
